services.name: Tiny Wheel Pottery
services.desc: Perfect for couples, families or friends, create your own tiny pottery projects on a special mini pottery wheel on the 1st Friday of each month! On the 1st Friday of each month, this fun class is taught step-by-step by a tiny wheel pottery specialist! If you’ve ever wanted to learn to throw pottery on a wheel, this is a great way for beginners to learn throwing basics, and for more experienced potters to try something unique and advance their skills. Our Tiny Wheel Pottery monthly events will show you how to create adorable mini pottery projects including tiny vases, bowls, pots, mugs, seasonal and novelty projects and more.
